premises.text: Recipients of remittances face agency travel, long waits, and fees up to 10%
premises.evidence_span: They have to pay for a bus to go to an agency, wait online for two hours, then go to another agency to pay their utility bills. On top of that, Western Union taxes them up to 10%

premises.text: Immigrants can send SMS credits usable like a gift card for food, medicine, bills, and tuition
premises.evidence_span: hardworking immigrants can send a credit directly to their family cell phone in Latin America that could be used to pay for food, medicine, utility bills, even tuition

premises.text: Senders can fund credits online or at partner mom-and-pop stores
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can visit us online or can visit us offline at one of 200 partner mom and pop stores

premises.text: Recipients can transfer part of the credit to others, making the remittance experience viral
premises.evidence_span: her sister also has the option to transfer part of those funds to a family member or another friend

premises.text: Retailer-location contracts subsidize a low flat $3 customer fee
premises.evidence_span: each of these retailers pay us a fee. which allow us to subsidize how much we charge our customers, a low flat fee of just $3

domains.name: SMS credit product and viral transfers

value.text: Immigrants fund families' basic needs back home via SMS
value.evidence_span: We allow immigrants to pay for all of their family's basic needs back home, all via an SMS
